profile.name: 线性电机滑台
profile.description: 用于实验平台上一维直线运动与定位的线性电机滑台。该设备支持通过网络连接、回零/参考点建立、设置负载与速度、执行绝对和相对位移、停止与恢复运动，并可读取当前位置、运动状态、回显信息及上次运动耗时，适合样品、机械臂末端或工装在导轨上的精密移动。
profile.description_en: A linear motor rail for one-dimensional motion and positioning in laboratory setups. It supports network connection, homing/referencing, load and speed configuration, absolute and relative moves, stop and resume control, and reading current position, motion status, device echo, and last move time. It is suitable for precise transport of samples, fixtures, or robot-mounted payloads along a rail.
